messages:
emma: quick heads-up — finalizing the private/VPC onprem bundle (installer + images) for tomorrow's 02:00 UTC delivery. artifacts are in staging-bucket:/releases/1.4.3/ and mirrored to airgap-host:/mirror/1.4.3. need packaging signoff, deploy-bot preflight, and ops escort confirmed. please ack and paste any checksum/signing proof here.

packaging: ack. running final tar + sig. current submanifest snapshot:```
- installer:v1.4.3@sha256:abc123...
- runtime:v2.0.1@sha256:def456...
- base-oci: pinned @sha256:feedbeef...
- airgap-bundle: 1.4.3.tar.gz.sig
```sha256sums uploaded to staging-bucket:/releases/1.4.3/checksums.txt

deploy-bot: preflight checks started 
- image availability: OK
- signatures: OK
- cosign verification: OK
- manifest schema: OK
Preflight result: PASS (run_id: db-2709876543-1) :white_check_mark: 

raj: quick q — did we pin the base-oci image or rely on semver tag? we should pin to sha for airgap customers.

packaging: pinned to sha256 (see submanifest). confirmed we built the installer against that exact base image. i added a note in the release submanifest field `base_image_digest` and exported a filtered manifest for the airgap mirror.

release-manager: rollback criteria draft: 
1) Canary error rate > 5% for 2 consecutive 5m windows.
2) Critical startups failing on >10% of hosts (healthcheck exit code != 0).
3) installer CRC mismatch on customer side (reported + verification fails).
If any of the above, immediate pin rollback to 1.4.2 and open incident channel #incidents. we will automate pin rollback by re-pointing the staging manifest and issuing a redeploy to dedicated pools.

mike: ops will provide escort and hold the transport window 02:00-03:00 UTC. I'll be oncall for the escort and will coordinate with the carrier for the physical mirror transfer. file delivery checklist: shipping manifest (signed), checksums, cosign sigs, carrier ETA.

emma: thanks. two ask items before we close: (1) packaging, paste the checksums url here (2) deploy-bot, attach the preflight run link so QA can replay. planning canary: 5% of dedicated fleet for 45m then 50% rollback window 30m.

packaging: checksums URL: https://staging-bucket.company/release/1.4.3/checksums.txt (signed by packer@redwood). also uploaded submanifest: https://staging-bucket.company/release/1.4.3/submanifest.json.sig

deploy-bot: preflight run details https://ci.redwood.internal/deploys/db-2709876543-1/logs. full artifact verification step shows all digests match; cosign signer ID: redwood-ops-kms-1.

release-manager: perfect. i'll publish a short release note snippet to the release-notes repo and schedule the canary start at 02:00 UTC. tagging the thread: @mike @raj @packaging @deploy-bot — please be on standby 01:45 UTC. :alarm_clock: 

mike: onstandby. moving escort booking to confirmed. :thumbsup:

emma: closing for now. if anything changes ping here or open #incidents. glhf :rocket:
